description: A stylesheet for the Navbar component, defining layout, visual styles, and responsive behavior for a navigation bar.

classes.description: Styles for the main navigation bar including layout and background color.

classes.description: Styles for a fixed positioning of the navbar.

classes.description: Styles for the container inside the navbar, ensuring proper spacing and alignment.

classes.description: Styles for the branding section of the navbar.

classes.name: mobileMenu
